meetings-extract.name: Meetings Extract
meetings-extract.description: Scan email cache for meeting-related threads and extract structured meeting packages. For each new meeting, enqueues the Gmail meeting label (and an archive if in the inbox and not watched) on email-updates; nothing while the account is report-only (emailConfig.reportOnly or accounts[].reportOnly).
meetings-extract.prerequisite: Gmail OAuth via gog (email pipeline must be running)

meetings-fetch-notes.name: Meetings Fetch Notes
meetings-fetch-notes.description: Fetch Gemini doc transcripts and extract Fathom share-page content for meetings missing transcripts.

meetings-ingest-notion.name: Meetings Ingest Notion
meetings-ingest-notion.description: Poll a Notion inbox database for new meeting pages and ingest them into the meetings pipeline.
meetings-ingest-notion.prerequisite: Notion API key + inbox database ID configured
